integrity: Analytic spectral decomposition and exact polynomial sign arguments; finite symbolic/rational checks corroborate but do not replace proofs. No claim of independent validation or exhaustive coverage of inaccessible literature.
limitations: Exactly two noise-free leaders, complete split networks with one core conductance and one cross conductance, identical follower noise intensities. General part sizes have a rational three-type minimum criterion; explicit successive weight-interval phases are established for three peripheral vertices.
title: Exact two-leader coherence and coupling-driven reallocation in weighted complete split networks
